programme.title: The Story of Us With Morgan Freeman
programme.desc: Humans are prone to aggression.Morgan Freeman sets off on another journey to find out the reasons for the cyclical nature of war and peace.He seeks answers to the question whether conflicts are inevitable.He notes that sometimes innovations are a side effect.During his trip, the actor witnesses ritual fights during a Bolivian festival.He also learns about a program aimed at reconciliation after the genocide in Rwanda.Morgan Freeman will try to find out whether the fear of annihilation will make people more cautious about starting hostilities.

programme.desc: This time, American Hazen Audel will travel through the wild regions of China.He will face further challenges that will test his knowledge, experience, endurance, and ability to survive in difficult conditions.The survival master will first go to Heilongjiang and Yunnan provinces.He is going on a fishing trip, which will become the main course during a great feast.In the hidden valley, he will be tasked with reconciling the members of two warring clans.The next destination is the beautiful Dulong River region in the southwestern part of the country.Together with the inhabitants of this place, he will try to overcome the stormy waters and get through forests full of bears and poisonous snakes.In the mountains you will find valuable herbs and honey guarded by wild bees.Hazen will have to return with supplies that will feed the people of the village and provide them with a decent income.As usual, the explorer will learn traditional techniques from the local people.Viewers will see if he can cope without modern tools and technology.
